    private var weeklyHourAlerts: [(name: String, week: String, hours: Double)] {
        return renderCache.value(for: ShiftRenderKey(revision: store.pdfRevision, location: store.selectedLocationID, scope: "labor|weeklyHourAlerts|" + monthPrefix)) {

        let calendar = Calendar(identifier: .gregorian)
        let dateFormatter = DateFormatter()
        dateFormatter.locale = Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")
        dateFormatter.dateFormat = "yyyy-MM-dd"
        let weekFormatter = DateFormatter()
        weekFormatter.locale = Locale(identifier: "ja_JP")
        weekFormatter.dateFormat = "M/d"
        var totals: [String: (name: String, week: String, hours: Double)] = [:]
        // Include neighboring-month shifts when checking a week that overlaps the selected month.
        let staffByID = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: store.selectedStaff.map { ($0.id, $0) })
        for assignment in store.selectedAssignments {
            guard let date = dateFormatter.date(from: assignment.dateKey),
                  let interval = calendar.dateInterval(of: .weekOfYear, for: date),
                  let staff = staffByID[assignment.staffID] else { continue }
            let weekEnd = calendar.date(byAdding: .day, value: 6, to: interval.start) ?? interval.start
            let selectedEnd = calendar.date(byAdding: .month, value: 1, to: selectedMonth) ?? selectedMonth
            guard interval.start < selectedEnd && weekEnd >= selectedMonth else { continue }
            let key = staff.id.uuidString + "_" + dateFormatter.string(from: interval.start)
            let current = totals[key]
            totals[key] = (staff.name, weekFormatter.string(from: interval.start) + "〜" + weekFormatter.string(from: weekEnd), (current?.hours ?? 0) + ShiftLaborEstimate.paidHours(assignment))
        }
        return totals.values.filter { $0.hours > 40.0 }.map { (name: $0.name, week: $0.week, hours: $0.hours) }
            .sorted { $0.hours > $1.hours }
    
        }
    }
